name: matematex-layout-conformance
description: Dev-only harness: diff the Matematex layout walker against KaTeX rendered in a real browser. Scoped here so the repo root stays package.json-free.
//: No "type": "module" — that would make node treat the .ts files here as ESM and break ts-node's CJS loader. capture-reference.mjs is explicitly ESM via its extension.
